Scenarios

🏗️ What You're Seeing

🤖

Agent Mobility

Watch agents move between contexts with their state intact. AMCP's strong mobility allows agents to migrate, clone, and replicate across the mesh.

📡

Event-Driven Communication

Agents communicate through asynchronous events on topics. No direct coupling - agents publish and subscribe to topics of interest.

🌐

Distributed Orchestration

Complex workflows emerge from simple agent interactions. Watch how order processing, IoT coordination, and chat flows work seamlessly.

⚡

Real-time Scalability

Add and remove agents dynamically. The mesh adapts automatically without reconfiguration or downtime.
